# Data assumptions

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate_docs.py from good/migrate.py. Do not edit by hand. -->

`good.migrate.from_v1()` introduces the values below when converting GOOD 1.x graphs.
Values marked PLACEHOLDER or ASSUMPTION should be reviewed before results are published.
Pass a modified copy of `good.migrate.ASSUMPTIONS` to `from_v1(graph, assumptions=...)`
to change them.

## `vre_capex_rescale`

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| `value` | 1e+09 |

Source: v1 wind/solar capex_cost equals EPA Platform v6 base capital cost (Table 4-16, 2023 vintage) plus regional adder (Tables 4-40, 4-44) in $/kW divided by 1e6; multiplying by 1e9 gives $/MW.

## `solar`

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| `fom_cost` | 10,740 |
| `capital_charge_rate` | 0.0978 |
| `capacity_credit` | 0.1 |

Source: FOM: EPA Platform v6 Table 4-16, solar PV 2023 vintage, $10.74/kW-yr. Charge rate: Table 10-9. Capacity credit: PLACEHOLDER; IPM Table 4-32 gives 0-90% ranges by resource class that fall with penetration.

## `battery_new`

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| `capex_cost` | 1.977e+06 |
| `fom_cost` | 35,000 |
| `operating_cost` | 7.1 |
| `duration` | 4 |
| `round_trip_efficiency` | 0.85 |
| `lifetime` | 15 |
| `discount_rate` | 0.0746081 |
| `capacity_credit` | 1 |

Source: EPA Platform v6 Table 4-35 (AEO 2018): $1,977/kW (2023, 4-hour, 2016$), FOM $35/kW-yr, VOM $7.1/MWh, 85% efficiency, 100% reserve margin contribution. Lifetime 15 years is an ASSUMPTION; the discount rate is the real rate implied by IPM's 9.78% charge rate over 20 years.

## `battery_existing`

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| `duration` | 4 |
| `round_trip_efficiency` | 0.85 |

Source: Same performance as new batteries (EPA Platform v6 Table 4-35). Duration of existing batteries is an ASSUMPTION; many pre-2022 batteries are 1-2 hours.

## `hydro`

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| `energy_budget_window` | 24 |

Source: Monthly hydro index becomes a daily energy budget: each plant may generate capacity_factor x shape x capacity per day and up to full capacity in any hour.
